name: script-execute
description: Last resort: check chievfx://instructions/core-descriptors for a real tool first. Runs C# (csharpCode, or csharpPath to a .cs file): static Main, methodName/className, or bare statements; returned Task/UniTask is awaited. New assembly per call: keep values in ChievfxMcpScriptState.Set/Get<T>/Remove, undo on Play exit via OnCleanup(name, action). Missing usings and private members are retried.

csharpPath.description: Path of a .cs file to run instead of csharpCode: absolute, or relative to the project root.
